title: Vehicle Damage Liability, Tolls and Citations under the Bluegate Moving Truck Rental Contract
content:
**Risk terms of the Bluegate Moving Truck Rental contract.**

1. Vehicle damage found at return or reported during the rental is charged according to the waiver taken at pickup.
2. With no waiver the renter owes the full repair estimate.
3. With the basic waiver the renter owes the repair estimate up to the class basic waiver deductible, and with the premium waiver up to the class premium waiver deductible — that is, the lower of the repair estimate and the deductible.
4. Neither waiver applies to damage to the cargo box roof or cab-over from striking an overhead object on a class whose schedule excludes overhead-strike damage, nor under any of the class void conditions (unauthorized driver, driving under the influence, off-road use, overloaded); then the full estimate is owed.
5. Tolls and citations received after the rental are passed through with the class administrative fee for each one.
6. Mechanical failure that is not caused by misuse is never charged to the renter.
7. Each incident is charged once: a damage charge or a toll and citation fee already posted against the same damage report or notice number is not posted again.

The repair estimate is the fleet shop's estimate on the incident record; the waiver taken is the waiver recorded on the contract at pickup; any reason a waiver does not apply is recorded on the incident.

## Liability table (hypothetical repair estimate of 1,200.00 on a Bluegate 10 ft Moving Truck: basic deductible 750.00, premium deductible 0.00, overhead-strike damage excluded)

| Waiver taken | Damage and circumstances | Owed by the renter |
|---|---|---|
| None | Side panel scraped | 1,200.00 — the full repair estimate |
| Basic | Side panel scraped | 750.00 — the estimate up to the deductible |
| Premium | Side panel scraped | 0.00 — the estimate up to the deductible |
| Basic | Cargo box roof struck on a low overhead object | 1,200.00 — the waiver does not apply |
| Premium | Side panel scraped while the vehicle was overloaded | 1,200.00 — a void condition applies |
| Basic | Repair estimate of 400.00 | 400.00 — the estimate is below the deductible |

On a Bluegate Pickup Truck or Bluegate Cargo Van, whose schedule does not exclude overhead-strike damage, a roof struck on an overhead object is charged under the waiver taken like any other covered damage.
